name: English
start: Hi, I'm Sapa, the new-hire check-in assistant. Please use the invite link from HR to join.
invalidInvite: This invite link can't be used. Please ask HR for a new link.
managerLinked: Linked. Sapa will message you here when HR assigns an action to you. Send /whatican to see what you can see in Sapa.
whatICanSee: What I can see: a weekly count of what your team's new hires named, shown as fewer than 3 when the count is small. You never see what new hires write. Sapa never ranks teams or managers. HR sees your team's count only when a problem is more common there than in the company, so help reaches you. You never see other teams.

action.several: Several new hires in {team} named {driver} in the last weekly snapshot ({n} of {m} who answered).
action.person: This is about {name}, one of your new hires.
action.personUnnamed: This is about one of your new hires.
action.fewer: Fewer than 3 new hires in {team} named {driver} in the last weekly snapshot.
action.noSnapshot: There is no weekly snapshot with enough people to show a count yet.
action.accepted: Accepted. Tap Mark done when it is finished.
action.unavailable: This action is not open any more.
action.idle: Sapa will message you here when HR assigns an action to you.
action.demoLabel: In real use this alert waits until {weekday}
action.scoreHeadline: {driver}, {scope} {change}, other teams {other} in the same weeks
action.scoreNote: Teams picked for a fix often improve anyway. This compares them with other teams.
action.evidenceRise: {driver} rose {diff} {direction} than in other teams ({n} people).

typeInstead: Sapa can't handle voice notes, pictures or files yet. Please type your message instead.
consent: Sapa asks you a few short questions during your first six months. Taking part is voluntary. Only HR can read your answers, never your manager. You can type STOP at any time to end everything. HR sees your name with your answers. Sapa keeps your chat ID only to send you questions, and Telegram can see this chat. Do you agree to take part?

yourName.question: What is your name? HR will see it with your answers. Your manager will not.

firstJob.question: Is this your first full-time job?
firstJob.thanks: Thanks. Sapa will message you for your next check-in.

declined: No problem. You won't get any more messages from Sapa.
skipped: Skipped. This check-in is closed. Sapa will message you for the next one.
stopped: You have stopped. Sapa will not send you any more messages.
help: You can type /help, /stop, or STOP at any time. Sapa will message you for your next check-in.

ask.name: ask
ask.description: Ask a question about the company

say.name: say
say.description: Help me say it to my lead

say.prompt: Type the message you want to send to your lead, in any language.
say.label: AI suggestion. Check it before you send:
say.send: Copy it and send it to your lead yourself. Sapa does not send or keep it.
say.down: Sorry, I cannot help with that right now. Please try again later.

qa.askPrompt: Type your question after /ask, or just type it here.
qa.disclaimer: Disclaimer: This is an AI answer, double check with HR for important information.
qa.unknown: I don't know yet. I have logged your question for HR, without your name.
qa.greeting: Hi, I am Sapa. Ask me anything about the company handbook, like leave, pay day or overtime. You can also type /help.
qa.important: This is an important matter, so I will not answer it. Please speak to HR directly:
qa.fallback: This answer is in {language}. Ask HR if it is not clear.

checkin.intro:
Hi, it's time for your Sapa check-in.
Your HR team sees your name and what you write. Your manager sees neither.
checkin.reminder: A gentle reminder: your Sapa check-in is still open. Pick up where you left off, or ignore this and it will close.
checkin.thanks: Thank you, your answers are saved.

questions.text: How clear are you on what is expected of you this week?
How much support did you get from your manager this week?
How connected are you with your team this week?
How clear are the company's direction, policies and procedures to you this week?
How well is your job training preparing you for your work this week?
How manageable is your workload this week?
Is there anything about your first weeks that you would like HR to know? Please type your answer.
How much does the job match what you were told when you were hired?
Since the last Update from HR about {topic}, how has it changed for you?

checkin.gotIt: Got it. Your answer is saved and HR will look at it.

probes.text: Could you tell me a bit more about that?
Which tasks or priorities are unclear to you right now?
What support would you like from your manager?
What would help you feel more part of the team?
Which part of your workload is hardest to manage?

chat.light: Anything that would make next week easier?
chat.askHr: I cannot give advice or answer questions about pay, probation, health or legal matters. Please ask HR directly.
chat.wait: Thanks. One moment while I write your last question…
chat.optional: Optional. Tap Skip if you prefer not to answer.

probe.example: Can you give one example from this week?
probe.effect: How does that affect your work?

ROLE_CLARITY.open: What is not clear about what is expected of you?

MANAGER_SUPPORT.open: What did you need from your manager this week?

BELONGING.open: What made it hard to work with your team this week?

ONBOARDING.open: Which company policy, procedure or benefit is still unclear to you?

TRAINING.open: Which part of your work did the training not cover?

WORKLOAD.open: What takes up most of your time this week?

offer.text: HR would like to help with what you shared. Would you like a short private chat?
offer.accepted: Thank you. HR will contact you within 2 working days.
offer.declined: No problem. Thank you for telling us.

nudges.7: Day 7 for {name}: Book a 15-minute priorities chat.

closure: HR has finished looking into what you shared. If you want to talk to HR again, you can reach them here:

safety.message: Thank you for telling us. This is serious. Please report it to HR through Contoh Speak Up. You can stay 100% anonymous.

if i quit i must pay

end: Your check-ins have ended. Your answers are kept until {date}. Type DELETE to remove them now.

exit.question: One last question, if you are willing: what was the main reason you left?
exit.open: Is there anything you want to add? Please type it.
exit.thanks: Thank you. Sapa will not message you again.

delete.confirm: This deletes all your answers, your questions and your link to Sapa. It cannot be undone. Delete everything?
delete.done: Done. Your answers and questions are deleted, and Sapa will not message you again.

myAnswers.pending: The AI has not read this answer yet.
myAnswers.challenged: Thank you. HR will check this label. It is not counted until HR has checked it.
myAnswers.resolved: HR checked your note. The label now reads:

export.intro: HR asked Sapa to send you the data Sapa holds about you. Here it is.
export.question: Your question:

contact.ask: Do you want HR to contact you?
contact.sharePrompt: Tap the button below to share your phone number with HR. Only HR can see it.
contact.thanks: Thank you. HR will contact you within 1 working day.
contact.noThanks: OK. HR will not contact you. You can still use the contacts above.
